title: VerdictRecord
description: One line of .claude/memory/verdict_log.jsonl -- a machine-logged reviewer/security-guard verdict, written by hooks/verdict_logger.py. Consumed by scripts/false_pass_rate.py.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of when the verdict was logged.

agent.description: Which agent issued the verdict. Only agents with a machine-parseable verdict format are covered -- see hooks/verdict_logger.py's honest-scope note.

verdict.description: LGTM/PASS = pass-class (the thing scripts/false_pass_rate.py measures against); NEEDS_WORK/BLOCK = fail-class, not counted as a pass to falsify. CONFIRMED-REAL/FALSIFIED/WEAKENED/NEEDS-REAL-DATA are skeptic's scientific verdicts (rules/skeptic-triggers.md Step 4); none is pass-class.

git_head.description: git rev-parse HEAD at the moment the verdict was logged. Null if not resolvable (e.g. not a git repo, detached weirdness).

files.description: Best-effort union of the last commit's changed files and the current working-tree diff -- the verdict could be about either.

model.description: Model id of the subagent's final non-synthetic assistant message, read from its own transcript. "unknown" when no transcript is on disk, when several transcripts match the ids, when the transcript is unreadable, when the event ids are missing or unsafe, when the final message records no model, or when the value is longer than 100 characters or not printable. Optional: records written before this field existed have no key.

run_outcome.description: Mapped from the stop_reason of the final assistant message: end_turn -> completed, max_tokens -> truncated, refusal -> refused, tool_use -> interrupted (inferred, see hooks/verdict_logger.py). "unknown" when no transcript is on disk, when several transcripts match the ids, when the transcript is unreadable, when the event ids are missing or unsafe, when the final message records no stop_reason, or when the value is not in this mapping (for example stop_sequence). Optional, as for model.

agent_id.description: skeptic records only: the subagent run id (with session_id it identifies the run).

evidence_claimed.description: skeptic records only: the skeptic's SELF-REPORTED evidence level (audit-verification-gate.md markers). A claim, not an attestation: this log never asserts independence, and VERIFIED-REAL without a data_ref is stored as UNVERIFIED.

criterion_ref.description: skeptic records only: the falsification criterion or its location, as written by the skeptic.

data_ref.description: skeptic records only: the source data / artifact the verdict rests on. Code version is git_head.
